title: Pakistan Commissions of Inquiry Amendment Act 1975

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Commissions of Inquiry Amendment Act 1975
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT XXIV OF 1975
ACT XXIV OF 1975
PAKISTAN
COMMISSIONS OF INQUIRY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend the Pakistan Commissions of Inquiry Act, 1956
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 20th February 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 15th February 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Pakistan Commissions of
Inquiry (Amendment) Act, 1975.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

The following Act of Parliament

2. General Amendment, Act VI
of 1956.----In the Pakistan Commissions of Inquiry Act, 1956 (VI of 1956),
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, for the words "Central
Government" wherever occurring the words "Federal Government"
shall be substituted.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Commissions of Inquiry Amendment Act 1975
sections.description:
Amendment of section 5, Act VI of 1956

ACT XXIV OF 1975
ACT XXIV OF 1975
PAKISTAN
COMMISSIONS OF INQUIRY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend the Pakistan Commissions of Inquiry Act, 1956
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 20th February 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 15th February 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
3. Amendment of section S, Act
VI of 1956.-In the said Act in section 5,-
(a) in subsection (1), after the
brackets and figure "(4)", the words, brackets, figure and letter
"or subsection (4-A)" shall be inserted; and
(b) after subsection (4), the
following new subsection shall be inserted, namely:-
(4-A) Where a Commission
consists of, or the President thereof is, a Judge of the Supreme Court or a
High Court, the Commission shall have the same power as the High Court has to
punish any person who-
(a) abuses, interferes with or
obstructs the process of the Commission in any way or disobeys any order of the
Commission;
(b) scandalizes the Commission or
otherwise does anything which tends to bring the Commission or a member of the
Commission in relation to his office into hatred, ridicule or contempt;
(c) does anything which tends to
prejudice the determination of a matter pending before the Commission; or
(d) does any other thing which,
by any other law, constitutes contempt of Court:
Provided that fair comment made
in good faith and in the public interest on the working of the Commission or on
its final report after the completion of the enquiry shall not constitute
contempt of the Commission.
(4-B) The exercise of the power
conferred 'on a Commission by sub-section (4-A) shall be regulated by rules
made by the Supreme Court".
